dt_edits.value: Throw a lit charge at an enemy. After their next turn, it explodes, dealing fire-type damage to them and adjacent enemies.
Plant a charge on a square. An enemy who steps on it sets it off, blasting them and adjacent enemies and igniting the ground.
Deal fire-type magic damage to enemies across 3 horizontal squares, and knock them back 2 squares.
Deal fire-type magic damage to enemies within range, lower their movement by 1 for %_BUFF_EFFECT_TURN_% turn(s), and set any ground ablaze.
Decreases TP cost of Scorch by 1.
Increases the range of Concussive Blast by 1.
Increases damage dealt by Concussive Blast.
Increases damage dealt by Sticky Charge's blast.
Increases the range of Oil by 1.
A young genius of the Archives who discovered how to make explosives, out to restore his family's honor.
